name: PSR J0537-6910 in N157B (Hubble)
blurb: PSR J0537-6910, a young X-ray pulsar at the center of the supernova remnant N157B in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: star05376910-hubble
story: Somewhere in this crowded field of stars spins a young pulsar, left at the heart of the supernova remnant N157B. Hubble searched here for a faint glimpse of this elusive object.

claims.text: PSR J0537-6910 (target STAR-0537-6910) is a fast, young X-ray pulsar at the center of supernova remnant N157B in the Large Magellanic Cloud
Hubble's ACS searched this field for the pulsar's elusive optical counterpart
